scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-asante in the 1800 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 150997.76105723923 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
